expectations.text: Route file created at src/app/api/reports/fuel-summary/route.js exporting a GET handler
Handler calls requireAuth, wraps logic in try/catch ending with handleError, returns ok(...)
expectations.evidence: Lines 4-23: `await requireAuth(req)`, try/catch ending `return handleError(e)`, `return ok(rows)`.

expectations.text: Aggregation done in SQL with GROUP BY (no JS reduce/forEach over fetched rows)
expectations.evidence: Single parameterized query with GROUP BY vehicle + TO_CHAR(fuel_date,'YYYY-MM'); no client-side accumulation.

expectations.text: Groups by vehicle and month (TO_CHAR/DATE_TRUNC on fuel_date), returning vehicle plate_number/vehicle_name
expectations.evidence: SELECT v.vehicle_id, v.plate_number, v.vehicle_name, TO_CHAR(f.fuel_date,'YYYY-MM') AS month ... GROUP BY v.vehicle_id, v.plate_number, v.vehicle_name, TO_CHAR(...); JOIN vehicles.

expectations.text: Returns total liters (SUM), total amount (SUM), and average price per liter (AVG(price_per_liter) or SUM(amount)/NULLIF(SUM(liters),0))
expectations.evidence: SUM(f.liters) AS total_liters, SUM(f.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(f.price_per_liter) AS avg_price_per_liter.

expectations.text: from/to params are parameterized with $1/$2 placeholders and default to a wide range
expectations.evidence: `const from = sp.get('from') || '1970-01-01', to = sp.get('to') || '2100-01-01'` passed as [from, to] to $1/$2.

expectations.text: getFuelSummary() added to src/services/fuel.service.js using apiFetch + buildQuery

claims.claim: Month key shape YYYY-MM matches existing fuel-consumption UI handling
claims.evidence: TO_CHAR(fuel_date,'YYYY-MM') matches the month substring used by the existing fuel-consumption report.

claims.claim: AVG(price_per_liter) used because the column is stored (nullable)
claims.evidence: price_per_liter column exists in 001_schema.sql; AVG ignores NULLs. Fallback documented in NOTES.md.
